notes.hook: a learner driver so scared of scratches he gets PPF, iron bumpers and bail papers ready
notes.what_goes_wrong: Speech starts at 2.5s, so the first frame must already show the nervous character; the garage name is said nowhere in the dialogue.
notes.reusable_pattern: Build a character whose exaggerated fear is exactly what your product solves; the product appears inside the joke (at 13s), not after it.
